$comment: Prompt-cache breakpoint placement policy. Per SPEC.md: four fixed breakpoints, plugin authors do not place them themselves. The conformance harness checks that nothing in a plugin's settings disturbs this layout.

breakpoints.name: tool-and-mcp-definitions
includes: MCP server definitions for any always-loaded server

breakpoints.name: active-capability-skill
includes: the body of the currently invoked SKILL.md

breakpoints.name: conversation-prefix
includes: the conversation history before the current user turn

rules: Plugin authors must NOT inject always-loaded content between breakpoints 2 and 3.
MCP servers default to alwaysLoad: false (per SPEC.md). Exceptions require justification in .cortex/manifest.json under mcp_servers_always_load.
Adding always-loaded content to the system prefix disturbs cache hits across all sessions. Use the active-capability-skill breakpoint instead.
